title: Life as an international student at the University of Edinburgh
description:
International student life at Edinburgh? Spoiler alert: we love it here! 🤩

University isn't just for studying, it's for living! With safe, green areas and a multicultural community, Edinburgh is one of the best cities in the world to be a student.  

Want a sneak peek? Lauren, Laura and Siddarth share their experiences as international students at the University of Edinburgh.  

Watch to learn more about where they live, how they have fun and what makes Edinburgh so special to them. Their insight could help you decide if this extraordinary place is where your future awaits. 

Ready to join us? Explore studying at Edinburgh as an international student ➡️ https://edin.ac/4mpdK4K  

⭐ Meet our students ⭐ 
Siddarth, from India, studying MScR-PhD Cardiovascular Biology 
Lauren, from the USA, studying MSc Psychological Research 
Laura, from Spain, studying MScR Reproductive Sciences 

 #universityofedinburgh #internationalstudentlife #studyinuk #edinburgh
